summary.text: Ike Puzon is the Republican nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 26 (3 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the U.S. Navy for 29 years and is president and CEO of Puzon & Associates.

paragraphs.text: Ike Puzon served in the U.S. Navy for 29 years, and his career experience includes working as president and CEO of Puzon & Associates.
Puzon was the Republican nominee for Maryland State Senate District 26 in 2018, losing the general election to Obie Patterson, who received 92.5% of the vote to Puzon's 7.1%.
He ran for the same seat in 2022 after winning the Republican primary unopposed, and lost the general election to C. Anthony Muse, 92.3% to 7.3%.
In 2026 he advanced from the Republican primary for the House of Delegates alongside JoAnn Fisher, with 48.9% of the vote.
